metaDesc: Polar Bear Pet Grooming: a bright, friendly dog grooming salon in Bakery Hill, Ballarat. Baths, brush-outs, breed clips, puppy grooms and nail trims. Book online or call 0407 182 862.

hero.title: Fresh, fluffy and happy, right here in Ballarat.
hero.lede: Polar Bear Pet Grooming is a bright, open salon in Bakery Hill where gentle groomers wash, brush and style dogs of every coat type, with treats along the way.

images.heroAlt: Fluffy white spitz after a groom
images.aboutAlt: Groomer cuddling a small white dog

servicesSub: Prices depend on your pet's size, coat condition and temperament. Call or book online for a quote.

services.title: Warm bath & blow dry
services.short: Short-coat bath and dry, quick brush-outs.
services.long: A warm bath and blow dry, with a thorough brush. Great for short-coated dogs or a freshen-up between full grooms.

services.title: Haircuts & breed clips
services.short: Curly and straight coats, traditional breed clips.
services.long: Haircuts and traditional breed clips for curly and straight coats, plus face, feet, ear, tail and feathering trims.

services.title: Puppy grooming
services.short: A gentle first groom for young pups.
services.long: Puppy grooms to get young dogs used to the salon, handled gently and patiently by the team.

services.title: Nails, ears & hygiene
services.short: Nail clipping, ear cleaning and tidy-ups.
services.long: Nail clipping, ear cleaning, and pads and hygiene shaves. Nervous dogs are handled calmly.

whyHead: Why Ballarat pets love Polar Bear
whyText: Our salon is bright, open and airy, and our groomers are gentle and affectionate. We use quality products and do our best to keep every pet relaxed during their visit.
why: Accessories, collars, leads and food in store

We also stock accessories, collars, leads and food, so you can pick up what you need when you collect your freshly groomed pet.
